--- page_www_aim_bhopal_org_courses_offered_.html ---
Courses Offered

MBA (General Management)

  ------------------------ -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Annual Intake            180
  Approved By              AICTE, New Delhi
  Affiliated to            Barkatullah University, Bhopal
  Recognised by            Directorate of Technical Education (DTE) Govt. of M.P.
  Year of Establishment    2015
  Admissions               Through Counseling conducted by Directorate of Technical Education (DTE) Government of Madhya Pradesh
  P.G. Degree Awarded by   Barkatullah University, Bhopal (State Govt. University)
  Duration of Programme    4 Semesters (2 years)
  Summer Training          In between I and III Semester
  Total Number of Papers   24
  Examination Pattern      Semester System.
  ------------------------ -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The programme prepares candidates for management careers in industry and
services. It is a two years full time programme, affiliated to
Barkatullah University, Bhopal, approved by AICTE, New Delhi and
recognised by Government of Madhya Pradesh. The students meeting the
programme requirements are awarded the Master’s Degree in Business
Management (MBA) from Barkatullah University, Bhopal. The programme
prepares the students to take up multiple responsibilities and energizes
them for the fast – track performance expected of them. It emphasizes
the development of student’s skills and abilities to apply management
theories and concept to live problems in business and industry. It also
enables students to acquire skills in identifying and dealing with
complex problems in management. Students undertake field based projects
so that they can get better insight into the business workplace reality.
The programme is spread over four semesters (two years). Thirty courses
are offered during this period. The first two semesters offer core
courses encompassing various managerial functions, essential for
managers to develop into future business partners. The third semester
focuses on a mix of core courses and specialization on any one from
Marketing, Human Resource and Finance. The last semester focuses on
electives to choose from International Business, Business and
Entreprenuership Management, Rural & Urban Management, Event Management,
Retail Management and Information Technology Management. The programme
is learning oriented and not ‘teaching oriented’. It is interactive and
participative involving fieldwork, case studies, business games,
role-plays, group discussions, presentations, and structures and
unstructured group work.

MBA (Full Time)

  ------------------------ --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Annual Intake            180
  Approved By              AICTE, New Delhi

  Examination Pattern      Semester System.
  Specialisations          Financial ManagementMarketing ManagementHuman Resource ManagementBanking & Financial Service Management Retail ManagementTravel and Tourism Management
  ------------------------ --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

MDPs

FDPs

The aim of the FDP is to attain sustainable development and achieve
higher growth rate by educating the teachers and staff members. At AIM
we assure the best in class faculty development program by involving
expert trainers from all domains to enhance the skills of the teachers
of AIM and also other institution.
--- page_www_aim_bhopal_org_admission_.html ---
Admission

MBA (FT)

MBA (FT) 2yrs Programme is Approved by All India Council for Technical
Education (AICTE) New Delhi, affiliated to Barkatullah University
Bhopal. Our reputation for strong academics combined with faculty who
are excellent teachers gives AIM is a powerful and transformational
academic experience. But we don’t stop there. We have a very active and
collaborative Student community that is the foundation for a successful
professional and social life while on the campus, and is a network for
lifetime.

Teamwork and communication are integral to the Programme. The students
take part in a number of group projects that promote group learning and
help improve the organizational and leadership skills. Through written
and oral presentations, the students develop the confidence to
effectively communicate their ideas in a corporate forum. These
presentations tend to be extremely helpful because they are critiqued by
professionals with extensive experience in the business arena. AIM’s
case competition provides an excellent showcase for the skills the
students have already developed.

An MBA from AIM is a step toward making a difference in the world. Our
alumni are making a major impact on their chosen professions and they
are finding innovative ways to redefine their industries.

AIM supports you in your professional journey — both as a student and as
an alumna/alumnus — and help open doors you never knew existed.

Eligibility for Admission

A candidates seeking admission to MBA should be a graduate with at least
50% marks (45% in case of SC, ST, OBC category) in aggregate of any UGC/
AICTE approved Indian University or from a Foreign University recognized
by Association of Indian Universities (AIU) or Institute recognized by
the concerned University as equivalent thereto. The Bachelor’s degree
must be of minimum three years duration after passing Higher Secondary
(10+2) examination of (10+ 2) year system or equivalent.

Recognized Post Graduate Degree of minimum 2 year’s duration.

Obtained at least 50% at the qualifying examination (45% in case of
candidate belonging to reserved category)

Other criteria as per Government / DTE/ BU / AICTE norms.

Domicile Requirement: As per the rules and regulation laid down by Govt.
of M.P. mentioned in rule book of DTE.

Procedure

Mode of Selection: The selection of the students is on the basis of
entrance examination held by the All India Council for Technical
Education New Delhi i.e. CMET where the candidates are short listed on
the basis of their quantitative abilities, logical reasoning skills and
verbal power. After this the final short listed candidates are called
for counseling by the Director of Technical Education as per their merit
to take admission in the Institute of their choice. At the end of the
process, 180 deserving candidates are chosen. These are the best
students in their fields the gems that will be polished to be jewels.
